summary: Activepieces is an open-source, no-code automation tool that connects different web services to trigger workflows. It allows you to build event-driven integrations, such as forwarding alerts between separate software applications without writing code.
goodFor: Teams looking for a self-hosted alternative to proprietary workflow automation services to retain data control.
watchOut: Self-hosting an automation platform introduces operational overhead in managing workflow execution queues, credentials, and potential failure states.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
